title: UI/UX Design - Part 2
description: User experience and user interface design principles using Figma, covering user research, wireframing, prototyping, usability testing, and developer handoff. This submodule covers: Design principles, Typography, Colors, Spacing, Components, Design systems.
learning_outcomes: Conduct user research and create personas
Design user journeys and information architecture
Apply UI/UX design principles and guidelines
